project.name: DDOT Coolidge - Area E bus storage electrical room (Chicago-plenum job)
project.author: tekton-ifc / rvt.electrical calc engine

notes: EXAMPLE DATA - a plausible, illustrative circuit/load list for the Area E electrical room panels so the calc engine and the panelboard-schedule deliverable can be demonstrated end to end. This is NOT the issued DDOT panel schedule. Panel/transformer identities (B-HG4 480Y/277 400A MCB feeding three 45 kVA dry-type transformers; 208Y/120 MLO branch panels B-LR1, B-LQ1, B-SLQ1) come from usecases/chicago-plenum-electrical-room/room-spec.json; every individual load below is invented for the example. All computed values are a DESIGN AID reviewed by the licensed engineer of record.

panels.notes: Area E 480Y/277 V distribution panel; feeds the three 45 kVA dry-type transformers plus 277 V plenum lighting and 480 V HVAC/motor loads. EXAMPLE data.
